description.value: Kokoro Tokyo Mazesoba is a Japanese franchise specializing in mazesoba — a broth-free dry noodle dish distinct from ramen or udon, originating in Tokyo. The River District location is one of several Canadian outposts of this growing international chain, offering 80 seats and outdoor seating in Vancouver's east side. Cyclists will find a filling, carb-forward meal with takeout and delivery options available.

OSM tags provide supplementary detail: toilets=yes/toilets:access=customers confirms customer washrooms; takeaway=yes is corroborated by the website's 'Order Online' link. No bike parking, Wi-Fi, or water refill information appears on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null. The brewery=various OSM tag is anomalous for a noodle restaurant and is flagged in concerns.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating noodle restaurant in Vancouver's River District with a recently verified OSM check_date of 2026-05-03 and a fully functional website. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a hot meal or takeout.
